//: Copy this to llm-review.config.json (gitignored) and edit. ALL fields are optional — with no config the tool just reviews the one repo.
//model: Which Claude model the reviewer runs on (default: sonnet).
//excludes: Extra git pathspecs to drop from the diff, on top of the built-in defaults (dist/build/out/coverage/node_modules, *.min.*, *.map, lockfiles). Use this for generated files specific to your repo — generated docs, snapshots, compiled protobufs, etc. Git pathspec magic: '*' also matches '/'.
//crossRepo: When the repo being reviewed matches `match` (regex on its absolute path), also give the reviewer read-only access to `related` repos and steer it with `hint`. First match wins. Omit entirely for a plain single-repo review. Set contractOnly:true to pull related repos in ONLY when the diff looks contract-relevant (endpoints/params/schema/migrations) — keeps unrelated changes fast and cheap.

crossRepo.hint: CROSS-REPO: this frontend renders data from the api-docs repo and calls the backend. When the diff changes how endpoints/params are resolved, verify against the actual docs and backend contracts; flag mismatches.

CROSS-REPO: the backend is the source of truth. For every changed endpoint, verify docs request params == the validator, response fields == what the handler actually returns, enums == the data model, method/path == the controller. Flag doc drift.
